# Editorial Format

Use for **`contentProfile: editorial`**. Short internal or column-style pieces (SEO audit report, site notes). **Not** used in the automatic draft replenish deck.

## Search intent

Internal ops, admin-only reports, site editorials — not primary AdSense product SEO pages.

## Section order

1. **Editorial Overview** / **편집부 개요** (or equivalent H2)
2. Short body with tables or bullet summaries as needed
3. Optional FAQ — not required (`MIN_FAQ` = 0)

## Rules

- Minimum body: EN/KO ≥ **800** characters (see `PROFILE_MIN_BODY_CHARS.editorial`)
- May set `robots: noindex` / `tags: internal` for admin-only pages
- Do **not** claim proprietary seller APIs
- Prefer public product formats (`buying-guide`, `head-to-head`, etc.) for publishable AdSense content
